item.title: Kara no Shoujo - The Second Episode
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Innocent Grey
  • 発売日: 2013-02-08
  • スコア: 8.49/10 (3731 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 虚ノ少女
  • 英語名: Kara no Shoujo - The Second Episode

别名

  • Kara no Shoujo 2

あらすじ

In the years before Japan went to war and the world went to hell, amidst the deep snows of the mountainous north, there was a small hamlet known as Hitogata where by ancient custom the residents were prone to worship clay dolls. One night, during their festival, a woman was murdered, and the people came to speak of this as their god’s curse—divine retribution for trying to take the power of their god into their own hands.

item.title: Caucasus ~Nanatsuki no Nie~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Innocent Grey
  • 発売日: 2009-12-11
  • スコア: 7.4/10 (461 人評価)
  • 日本語名: クロウカシス ～七憑キノ贄～
  • 英語名: Caucasus Nanatsuki no Nie

あらすじ

In the secluded mountains of the Tohoku region lies a village named Nanatsuki.

Drawn by tales of a peculiar local legend, two curious students from a Tokyo university decide to investigate.

Their journey, however, takes an unexpected turn when a blizzard engulfs them. Fortunately, they’re rescued by Benio, the second daughter of the influential Nanatsuki family, who welcomes them to their imposing black mansion, Shichitsuki-kan (The Mansion of Seven Possessions).

item.description:

  • ブランド: Innocent Grey
  • 発売日: 2006-09-29
  • スコア: 6.93/10 (150 人評価)
  • 日本語名: PP -ピアニッシモ- 操リ人形ノ輪舞
  • 英語名: PP -Pianissimo- Ayatsuri Ningyou no Rinbu

あらすじ

Tokyo, 1936.

Kudou Sousuke is a talented pianist who regularly performs at a jazz bar called “CADENZA.” One night, out of the blue, he finds himself in a pickle when a frenzied geisha suddenly attacks him on his way home. Despite being battered and bruised, Sousuke manages to weather the storm and makes a hasty exit.
